verdict.rationale: Zero's README states that it does not track or collect user data at all, so there is no telemetry to opt out of, and self-hosting gives users further control. This is a single first-party marketing claim with no documented opt-out setting, telemetry configuration or independent verification. Missing for 10: documented telemetry/analytics opt-out controls or config flags, a privacy policy detailing what the hosted service collects, independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-tracking claim.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Zero does not track, collect, or sell your data in any way.
gives users the power to **self-host** their own email app
